title: Settings
description: How projects group into mods, where the data comes from, and when it is fetched.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.modrinthToken: The Modrinth token is not set.
sources.modrinthTokenHidden: Hidden until it is: your drafts and projects that are still in review. Published projects still show.
sources.modrinthTokenFix: To fix it, create a personal access token on Modrinth with the project read scope, set it as MODRINTH_TOKEN where Modwatch runs, then restart it.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: Each mod is one entry. Links tie its CurseForge and Modrinth projects and its issue label together.
registry.caption: Registry of mods and their platform links
registry.emptyHint: Clear the search or the filter.
registry.emptyNoneHint: Entries appear after the first poll.
registry.label: Issue source
registry.legacyHint: Not updating for new Minecraft versions. It never raises a missing-version alert.
registry.legacyToggle: Not updating for new Minecraft versions
registry.manualHint: Set here. Auto-linking never changes it.
registry.onePlatformHint: Only on one platform. If the other project has a different name, merge them.
registry.relinkHint: Runs the matcher again. Links you set by hand stay.
registry.relinked: Re-linked. Entries set by hand were left alone.
registry.ownRepo: Its own repository, so no label is needed

unlinked.memberHint: You are a member of this project, not the owner.
unlinked.noTargets: Every entry already has a project here.
unlinked.emptyBody: No project or issue label is waiting for an entry.
unlinked.needsLabel: Entries with a label of their own are not offered.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.name: Name
edit.label: Issue label
edit.labelHelper: The part after “mod: ” on GitHub issues. Leave empty to use the slug, {{slug}}.
edit.labelBad: Lower case letters, digits and dashes.
edit.moves: {{name}} holds this project now. Saving moves it here.
edit.movesDeletes: {{name}} has no other links, so it is deleted.
edit.hiddenHelper: The entry stays here so you can bring it back.
edit.repoHelper: Only if this mod keeps its issues in a repository of its own, written owner/name. Every issue there belongs to this mod. Leave empty to use the shared repository and the label above.
edit.repoHelperSet: Every issue in this repository belongs to this mod, so the label above isn't needed.
edit.repoBad: Write it as owner/name, with letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

confirm.unlinkBody: The project goes to the Unlinked list.
confirm.notFoundBody: The link may be old. Pick a mod from the list.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Where Modwatch gets its data. Each value can come from an environment variable or be set here. A value set here wins. Clear it to go back to the environment variable.
connections.storage: Values set here are stored in the database in plain text. To keep a key out of the database, set its environment variable instead. That works the same.

curseforgeApiKey.label: Core API key
curseforgeApiKey.help: From console.curseforge.com. The tokens on the older API Tokens page get a 403.

modrinthUser.label: Username or id
modrinthUser.help: Leave it empty to turn Modrinth off.

modrinthToken.label: Personal access token
modrinthToken.help: Public projects need none. Drafts and projects in review stay hidden without one.

githubToken.label: Access token
githubToken.help: Optional. Without one GitHub allows 60 requests an hour. Needed for private repositories.

githubIssuesRepo.label: Shared issues repository
githubIssuesRepo.help: Written owner/name, such as FireBall1725/mod-issues. Leave it empty if every mod keeps its own.

metricsEnabled.label: Serve /metrics
metricsEnabled.help: When it is off, /metrics answers 404 and Prometheus shows the target as down. The environment variable is MODWATCH_METRICS_ENABLED.

connections.envToo: The environment variable is set too.
connections.saved: Saved {{label}}. It applies to the next poll.
connections.backToEnv: {{label}} now uses the environment variable. It applies to the next poll.
connections.cleared: Cleared {{label}}. It applies to the next poll.
connections.issueModes: Issues can live in one shared repository for every mod, where each issue has a mod: label, or in a repository for each mod, set in the registry below under Edit and Issues repository. You can use both. A mod with its own repository reads from it, and the rest use the shared one.
